summary: Iteration 005 adds a grounded local dialogue system to Bay-Max. Three dialogue backends are implemented (rule_based, ollama, transformers) with a shared provider interface, plan-then-verbalize prompt builder, safety gating on input and output, and graceful fallback. The /v1/respond endpoint now returns backend, model_name, fallback_used, and safety_flags. A new GET /v1/dialogue/backends endpoint exposes configuration. All 194 automated tests pass. Five smoke-test cases pass with rule_based backend. Ollama and Transformers backends are implemented but not exercised with real models in this environment.

dialogue_backends.notes: Default fallback. Always available. 5/5 smoke tests passed.
Implemented with urllib, configurable model. Not tested with real model — Ollama server not running in this environment.
In-process HF pipeline with lazy loading. Not tested with real model — model not downloaded in this environment.
